data.rationale: The proposal follows the same path (Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels > toll rates > select vehicle type) with vehicle type as a parameter, but it omits the facility parameter and the final view-rate step, and it is vague about the "Tolls by vehicle" click and how to pick the vehicle type, so an automation would need guesswork.
